title: Fix unfinished review lens treated as pass
goal: Make any review lens that does not finish count as a failure so the run stops and nothing merges unless every lens finishes and passes.

steps.description: Run `grep -rl 'ZBUILD_RUN_FLAGGED' tests/ plugins/` and add every match beyond the issue's named list to the scope, so no test that pins the old behaviour is missed and causes a build-loop failure.

Write or update tests for R1–R5 in all in-scope test files (engine-combines-map-test.sh M1/M2, map-members-reported-test.sh MR4–MR6, merge-policy-auto-unless-flagged-test.sh, pr-delivery-v2-result-test.sh, merge-v2-result-test.sh, pr-open-v2-result-test.sh, pr-open-v2-inputs-test.sh, pr-open-test.sh, and any grep-discovered matches); confirm every new or changed assertion fails against the current code before touching the implementation.

Amend ADR-040's #2368-part-2 amendment to state that an unfinished element (any outcome other than pass or fail, or no current result) counts as failed, a group with any failed or unfinished element is a failed stage that stops the run, and the run may merge only when every element finished and passed; add an 'Enforced by' subsection naming the tests from step-2.

Fix `_map_write_summary` in `core/pipeline/strategies/map.sh` so that any element whose outcome is not `pass` or `fail`, or that has no current result, causes the group to set `ZBUILD_RUN_FLAGGED=yes` and record a failed group verdict — matching the decision that unfinished equals failed.

Review `core/pipeline/runner.sh`'s `map:*` dispatch case and update it if it does not already stop the run (skip pr_open and merge) when the map group's verdict is failed, so the hard-stop behaviour required by R1 and R2 is wired into the live path.

Check `plugins/agent/pr-delivery/plugin.sh` and `plugins/tool/merge/plugin.sh` to determine whether the extended meaning of `ZBUILD_RUN_FLAGGED=yes` (now covering unfinished lenses) changes their behaviour path; update only if the flag's semantics require it.
Run the full test suite (`npm test`) to confirm R1–R5 pass, no regressions exist in unmodified tests, and the 29% coverage floor is met.
